_metadata.description: Operator-authorized configurable product presentation; planned validations remain unverified until observed.

requirements.title: Amended LPBS PRD and requirement registry with stable operational targets for the product-presentation model
requirements.description: The landing-page contract must define bundle scope, app scope, app visibility, single-app mode, multi-app mode, app slide limits, app ordering, detail routes, and acceptance parity between the single-app landing view and an app detail view.

validation.notes: Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. The contract names all requested single-app and multi-app behaviors and no downstream implementation evidence is treated as sufficient until the contract agrees with the request.

requirements.title: Canonical BAS app profile containing the recovered identity, narrative, feature copy, availability, installer metadata, screenshots/assets, and disabled/planned state
requirements.description: Existing Browser Automation Studio material must survive as an explicit disabled app profile without being silently deleted or diluted.

validation.notes: Canonical preservation gate checks the disabled/private/draft BAS profile, 1,071 field mappings, 9 payload digests, and 5 asset identities. It does not prove public cutover, real asset release, or owner qualification.

Parent race test proves exact UTF-8 recovery chunks and receipt survive typed draft save/read without publication, stale saves conflict, renderer projections omit private recovery bytes, and disabled BAS has no public route. This tests storage/transport, not the local import adapter itself.

Version1 explicit local adapter preserves exact source bytes and field dispositions, maps only safe narrative content into the selected disabled/private/draft app, rejects malformed or damaged provenance, and is deterministic and idempotent. No default network or persistence writes.

Opt-in cross-language bridge: actual canonical generated seed through the real TypeScript adapter then authoritative SaveDraft/GetPresentation validation. Parent passed synthetic edge cases and the archived agency BAS variant with byte-exact storage and no publication; default suites skip this opt-in artifact workflow.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A before/after content snapshot proves that every recovered BAS field is either preserved in the profile or explicitly marked as intentionally superseded by an accepted decision; generic Aquila sections contain no BAS-only copy.

requirements.title: Canonical app and bundle manifest with duplicate identity handling for Aquila/web-console and a documented Backdrop Studio product-versus-provider decision
requirements.description: The bundle must have one canonical catalog of independently marketable app profiles with explicit public status, stable key, slug, priority, detail route, launch/download targets, narrative, and visual assets.

validation.notes: Pure resolver matrix exercises zero, single, bundle, detail, configured order/cap, and private-profile exclusion.
Pure resolver test proves unknown/private public routes fail closed and explicitly authorized private preview remains separate.
Resolver preserves the supplied configured variant assignment instead of inventing a supported fallback.
Parent-owned bootstrap regression proves the seed uses the configured commerce/delivery bundle identity instead of the template bundle key while preserving historical facts.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Public resolution never relies on database insertion order or default-enabled records; only explicitly published apps participate in public bundle mode.

requirements.title: Versioned page/block schema and coverage audit that distinguishes configured content, shared system strings, and code-owned renderer behavior
requirements.description: All user-facing marketing copy and block data must be supplied by validated presentation configuration, app profiles, plan/catalog data, or shared localization/system strings rather than hidden product-specific JSX defaults.

validation.notes: Typed document and finite block content round-trip is exercised; this is not a public publication acceptance.
Typed discriminator mismatch is rejected.
Required shell/display fields, registered marks, references, actions, and finite variants are validated.
Draft, publish, and rollback persistence behavior is exercised; actual external owner publication verification remains pending.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/contentProvenance.test.ts::keeps named product copy and review fixtures out of production renderer modules
validation.notes: AST-based regression rejects named Aquila/BAS/Backdrop/Web Console marketing literals and review-fixture imports in public renderer modules. Comments and technical identities remain allowed. This is a narrow static guard, supplemented by configured-copy renderer tests, not a guarantee about arbitrary future marketing claims.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A static/content provenance check fails for stale BAS or Web Console marketing strings in generic public renderers and validates every configured block type before publication.

requirements.title: Server-side presentation resolver covering zero, one, and multiple public apps
requirements.description: The resolver must render a product-led page when exactly one public app is available and a bundle-led page when multiple public apps are available.

validation.notes: Server-side zero, one, multiple, and detail resolution matrix passes against configured app membership and order.
Spotlight cap is consumed page-wide across multiple spotlight blocks.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Zero-app, one-app, and two-or-more-app fixtures produce deterministic mode, scope, hero, CTA, pricing/download behavior, and app ordering without frontend first-app inference.

requirements.title: Configurable app rail/spotlight block with deterministic app order and `/apps/:appKey` detail routing
requirements.description: A multi-app bundle must show at most configured k app slides, and every app slide must link to a complete app-specific route.

validation.notes: Hero exhibit capacity remains independent from the page-wide spotlight cap, with configured app order retained.
App-specific public and authorized-preview route behavior is exercised.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::keeps artwork panels in one identified app group and preserves resolved catalog order
validation.notes: UI projection keeps multiple artifacts within one identified app group and preserves resolved catalog order.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A fixture with more than k public apps renders exactly k in configured order; each link resolves to its app scope and does not fall back to a generic download card.

requirements.title: App-detail presentation API and UI route with parity tests
requirements.description: App detail pages must use the same composition engine and product scope as the main page would use when that app is the only public app.

validation.notes: Root/detail block, capability, asset, fixture, and digest parity is asserted for the rich app fixture.
Root/detail display parity and response immutability are asserted.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::renders edited content in app_detail without a page-name heuristic or executing HTML
validation.notes: UI app-detail rendering uses configured content and does not substitute page-name heuristics.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. The resolved block digest, order, app identity, hero narrative, pricing/download treatment, and CTA targets are equal between single-app mode and the corresponding detail route, except for route metadata and explicitly configured bundle navigation. Tag correction: LP-PRES-007 belongs on the root/detail parity tests, not asset-release or variant-diagnostic tests.

requirements.title: Order resolver and validation rules for page blocks, app slides, and scoped overrides
requirements.description: Configured block order must be authoritative; hidden renderer sorting may not move downloads, footer, or other blocks without an explicit schema constraint.

validation.notes: Repeated resolution is deterministic and response mutation does not alter the configured document.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/admin-portal/presentation/PresentationEditorRoute.test.tsx::reorders only the explicitly moved pages and blocks
validation.notes: Authenticated editor reordering is exercised against explicit page/block moves.
Invalid display/block references and unsupported variants fail validation.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A fixture with reordered blocks produces the requested order, while invalid mandatory-placement constraints fail validation with an actionable diagnostic.

requirements.title: Validated backdrop reference fields for hero, app spotlight, and app-detail assets, plus same-origin resolution and release metadata
requirements.description: Backdrop Studio must be used as a released, surface-specific visual asset provider with reserved regions and legibility evidence, while LPBS remains responsible for HTML, copy, and page composition.

validation.notes: Asset publication requires generated same-origin delivery URL and descriptor agreement.
Document asset URL, dimensions, measurement, and provenance checks are exercised; owner release qualification remains pending.
Asset verifier composition remains read-only and propagates the request lease; it does not create release evidence.
Public asset-bearing documents fail closed without an asset verifier.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::uses canonical backdrop selection and rejects a mismatched selection
validation.notes: UI consumes canonical resolved backdrop selection and rejects a mismatched selection.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A configured reference resolves to a released asset and metadata for desktop and mobile surfaces; missing, stale, or illegible references fail or use an explicit configured fallback rather than silently rendering an empty or black frame. Tag correction: LP-PRES-009 belongs on presentationassets publication/provenance, asset-composition, and qualification-gate tests; recording and generic landing diagnostics are not asset-release evidence.

requirements.title: Catalog/app spotlight block and app profile visual asset treatment for desktop and mobile
requirements.description: The catalog must communicate product value through designed visual cards, screenshots or released backdrop compositions, availability status, and a clear view-details action.

validation.notes: Public asset identity is checked against cache and wire projection.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::reads native demo content and asset URLs only from canonical resolved arrays
validation.notes: UI exhibit content and asset URLs come from canonical resolved arrays.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::keeps artwork panels in one identified app group and preserves resolved catalog order
validation.notes: UI preserves identified app grouping/order; real released visual asset availability remains unverified.
Configured hero app groups remain distinct from the spotlight cap.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Given a fixture with public Aquila and Backdrop Studio and disabled BAS, when the public catalog renders, then it shows two distinct product presentations with clear detail actions; BAS remains available only through an authorized private preview.

requirements.title: Evidence preflight and recording assertions covering first frame, frame diversity, content landmarks, desktop/mobile dimensions, and route identity
requirements.description: Evidence capture must detect blank, black, stale, or mismatched presentation output instead of returning a superficially successful recording.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::captures every configured section in its configured order, never path-shaped labels
validation.notes: Capture journey configuration and landmark ordering are exercised.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::rejects a uniform white recording as well as uniform black
validation.notes: Uniform blank/black/white output is rejected.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::rejects a frozen recording when the planned journey required a page change
validation.notes: Frozen capture output is rejected when the configured journey requires change.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::fails closed for route/variant/revision/viewport mismatch, overlays, assets, and decoder errors
validation.notes: Capture identity, viewport, overlay, asset, and decoder failures are fail-closed.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::captures headed and headless page-bound desktop/mobile journeys and validates the real video
validation.notes: The executable capture path covers desktop/mobile journey dimensions; integrated current-capability release evidence remains pending.

Opt-in LPBS_RUN_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 run passed for both variants in effort evidence/integrated-20260915T1110. Real ConfigStore/public API/SSR/production UI use isolated leased roots and fake qualification. Desktop/mobile video, ordered frames, pinned page payloads, private BAS404 and missing/expired lease503 are verified. Default Go runs skip this expensive opt-in test; no public cutover or real release is claimed.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-budget.test.mjs::expires once, aborts its signal, and invokes the expiry callback once
validation.notes: Bounded capture budget expires and aborts exactly once. This is part of the 25-test explicit UI test:evidence entrypoint.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. A black or blank fixture fails before handoff; a valid recording proves non-black pixels, expected Aquila/app landmarks, and the intended resolved variant and route. Tag correction: LP-PRES-011 belongs on scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs preflight and recording assertions; current worker tags on branding or landing action tests are not recording evidence.

requirements.title: Variant resolution diagnostics, explicit fallback metadata, and evidence labeling/guardrails
requirements.description: Configured variant failure must be visible and diagnosable; the runtime must not silently substitute the fallback page while evidence is presented as proof of the requested variant.

validation.notes: Content digest encoding errors propagate instead of becoming a fabricated digest.
Requested and resolved variant assignments remain explicit and are not relabeled by the resolver.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::rejects requested control when only the URL query says control
validation.notes: Capture evidence rejects a variant label supported only by URL query state.

validation.ref: scripts/capture-public-evidence.test.mjs::fails closed for route/variant/revision/viewport mismatch, overlays, assets, and decoder errors
validation.notes: Capture diagnostics expose route, variant, revision, viewport, asset, and decoder mismatches.
Landing response diagnostics distinguish explicit variant selection from missing exposure facts.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. The API and capture pipeline expose requested variant, resolved variant, fallback state, and reason; a capture for control cannot be labeled control when the response is fallback. Tag correction: LP-PRES-012 belongs on resolver/landing diagnostics and capture variant-mismatch tests; asset-release and recording-only tags are not diagnostic evidence.

requirements.title: App capability records, evidence/constraint fields, artifact-explorer and voice-story blocks, session narrative and a distinct roadmap block, shared by single-app and detail routes
requirements.description: When Aquila is presented, the product page MUST explain local STT/TTS, AI summarization, supported artifact viewing, grouping, session search, and archive/unarchive through configured app-owned content; remote-computer and Android/iPhone control MUST remain explicitly coming soon until release evidence supports availability.

validation.notes: Referenced fixtures/assets resolve through public closure while private evidence is redacted.
Capability ownership and references remain within the owning app/page.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::renders configured block order, rich exhibits, and coming-soon claims
validation.notes: Configured rich exhibits and coming-soon claims are rendered from the resolved page.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::supports tab keyboard navigation, focus, panel relationships, Home and End
validation.notes: Artifact/presentation keyboard navigation and panel relationships are exercised.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::switches terminal/conversation views and closes mobile navigation with Escape
validation.notes: Configured terminal/conversation exhibit views and mobile navigation behavior are exercised.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Given the same Aquila profile revision, when single-app root and detail routes render, then capability copy/status and order agree; artifact selection works with pointer and keyboard; local speech does not imply all AI processing is local; upcoming device control has no current connect/control action.

requirements.title: Validated hero-exhibit configuration and supported composition variants, with explicit app identity, order, eligibility and detail targets
requirements.description: When the bundle hero contains app exhibits, the renderer MUST use configured eligible app references and show one identifiable visual group per selected app with a matching detail link; multiple artifacts within one group MUST NOT imply additional apps.

validation.notes: Hero groups retain configured eligible app identity/order independently of spotlight cap.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/decode.test.tsx::keeps two eligible configured hero apps when k=0 and slide keys are empty
validation.notes: UI decoder preserves eligible hero apps when the spotlight slide cap is zero.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/public-landing/presentation/PresentationPage.test.tsx::keeps artwork panels in one identified app group and preserves resolved catalog order
validation.notes: Multiple artifacts remain one identified app exhibit group with matching resolved order.
Unknown app refs, unsafe actions, invalid assets, and unqualified capability inputs fail validation.

Pending acceptance procedure; not implementation evidence. Given two public apps and disabled BAS, when the hero renders, then exactly two identified app groups and matching detail links appear; reordering the configuration changes their order, disabled apps are excluded, invalid duplicate/unknown identities fail validation, and the hero does not increase the configured detailed-slide cap.
